no_machine_detail: Persona works on one of your computers, and none is connected yet.
machine_pending_detail: Confirm that {machine} is your computer before Persona can work on it.
node_unreachable_detail: {machine} is offline right now. It may be asleep, or Persona Link isn't running.
node_outdated_title: Persona on {machine} is out of date
node_outdated_detail: Update Persona Link on {machine} so the main conversation can run there.
claude_missing_detail: Claude Code isn't installed on {machine} yet. Install it, or use an API key instead.
launcher_missing_detail: Can't find the model entry “{launcher}” on {machine}. It may have been removed.
not_logged_in_detail: Sign in once on {machine}, or use an API key instead.
model_not_logged_in_switch_detail: Sign in on {machine}, use an API key, or choose another app or setup to run the main chat on that computer in Settings › Model.
auth_failed_detail: The model's key is wrong or has expired. Use one that works.
model_fallback_unavailable_title: The refusal fallback model is unavailable
model_fallback_unavailable_detail: The upstream refused the request, so Claude Code switched this session to a fallback model that the service cannot use. Start a new conversation, or use /model in the Claude Code terminal to choose the original model. Nothing is resent automatically; the request may be refused again.
model_route_detail: The model name is wrong, or the model isn't available right now. Try another model.
rate_limited_title: The model is being used too fast
rate_limited_detail: The model is being used too fast right now. It will recover on its own.
model_unverified_title: The model hasn't been checked yet
model_unverified_detail: Send a message to check that the model answers.
model_key_unverified_detail: Claude Code on {machine} uses an account or key it was set up with, not tried yet. Send a message to check that it works.
never_tried_detail: Send “Hello” and see whether Persona answers.
suggest_what_can_you_do: What can you do for me?
suggest_how_to_connect_model: How do I connect a model?
suggest_largest_folders: Show the largest folders on this computer
suggest_largest_folders_prompt: Show me the largest folders on this computer.
suggest_connect_mail_prompt: Teach me how to connect my email to Persona.
